diagnosis.what_happened: Appending w:bidiVisual out of sequence in w:tblPr caused strict parsers to drop RTL formatting.
diagnosis.behavior_caused_outcome: Strict ECMA-376 parsers (ONLYOFFICE) reject out-of-order schema elements, nullifying RTL table orientation.
diagnosis.what_should_have_happened: Validators and builders should enforce strict ECMA-376 sequence: bidiVisual before tblW, jc after tblW.
diagnosis.rationale_why: OpenXML relies on precise sequence ordering inside properties blocks; deviation leads to silent failure.

desired_behavior: Mandating strict ECMA-376 CT_TblPr schema ordering: bidiVisual w:val="1" before tblW, jc w:val="right" after tblW, and section-level w:bidi w:val="1" in w:sectPr.
generalization: XML and OpenXML mutations must strictly adhere to element sequence ordering as defined in the schema, not just presence.

evidence.observed_value: Out-of-order elements caused LTR rendering despite tag presence.
